tools.name: gmaps_me
tools.description: Get current GMaps Lead Finder plan and credit balance for the authenticated API key.

tools.name: gmaps_create_job
tools.description: Create a Maps search job for exactly one keyword. Shares the single in-flight job limit with the web app (409 if another job is running).

tools.name: gmaps_get_job
tools.description: Get maps job status and per-keyword file metadata. Poll until status is completed, partial, or failed.

tools.name: gmaps_get_results
tools.description: Fetch paginated place rows as JSON for a finished maps job (respects user export column preferences).

tools.name: gmaps_create_reviews_job
tools.description: Create a Google Maps reviews scrape job for exactly one place (Maps URL, maps.app.goo.gl / goo.gl/maps short link, or business_id 0x…:0x…). Shares the single in-flight job limit with maps jobs (409 if busy).

tools.name: gmaps_get_reviews_job
tools.description: Get reviews job status. Poll until status is completed, partial, or failed.

tools.name: gmaps_get_reviews_results
tools.description: Fetch paginated review rows as JSON for a finished reviews job.

tools.name: gmaps_create_photos_job
tools.description: Create a Google Maps photos scrape job for exactly one place (Maps URL, maps.app.goo.gl / goo.gl/maps short link, business_id 0x…:0x…, or Place ID ChIJ…). Shares the single in-flight job limit (409 if busy).

tools.name: gmaps_get_photos_job
tools.description: Get photos job status. Poll until status is completed, partial, or failed.

tools.name: gmaps_get_photos_results
tools.description: Fetch paginated photo rows as JSON for a finished photos job.
